title: Parish and Ledger
author: Noor Vane
blurb: Quentin Underhill, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
